newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shandong engineering to list A shares in Shenzhen.
newsitem.headline: Shandong engineering to list A shares in Shenzhen.

text.p: Bulldozer maker Shandong Shantui Engineering Machinery Co Ltd will list 101.1 million A shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on January 22, a company spokesman said on Thursday.

The stock is composed of 88.6 million shares issued at 4.28 yuan each on the Shenzhen bourse last month, and 12.5 million shares offered at 1.20 yuan each in 1993, he told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.

The firm raised 373 million yuan in net proceeds from its latest equity offer, the official said. It will use 257 million yuan to expand its output of bulldozers and the rest to repay bank borrowings and supplement working capital, he said.
Based in the city of Jining in eastern Shandong province, the firm has the capacity to turn out 1,200 bulldozers annually, the official said.

After the listing, the firm's share capital will total 235.6 million shares, consisting of 82.5 million state shares, 50 million employee shares, two million corporate shares and 101.1 million A shares.
He said the company estimated its 1996 net profits at about 50 million yuan, compared with 34.25 million yuan in 1995 and 40.76 million yuan in 1994.
